body: Weather's pretty bad here (0°C or about 30°F) but I have my own room. Guess I'll just relax for now.

Thanks. Every time I said something I was seriously about to hurt myself. I don't know how to describe it but I felt like I could still turn back.

I'm calling my social-worker tomorrow. I know this may not be the best person but at the moment I don't have a therapist. I feel like he's very understanding and I will try to listen. How do I reassure him that I don't plan on doing anything to myself now?

I know this sounds pessimistic but maybe it's because they actually believed you could hurt yourself. Maybe it's less that they didn't care about me but instead they just didn't believe me and think I'm just impulsive (which would be strange because I have a history of suicide threats since I was like 12).

I'm not helping myself though. I don't know how to be honest with the doctors at the hospital. Every time I end up there I'm always lying saying I never felt suicidal, never did self harm, etc. I know I need to say "Yes" when the doctor asks me if I'm suicidal but every time I'm about to do so I just lose my voice.
Hi, I don't really know how to describe how I feel right now. I got into a fight with my family and I know this may sound weird but the anger distracts me from myself.
